name: gauge
description: Context, cost and rate limits in the status line, warnings at thresholds you set, a compact helper, and /gauge for per-turn figures, the context breakdown and spend history.

warnTokens.title: Warn at context tokens
warnTokens.description: A toast warns once when the context passes this many tokens. 0 turns it off.

warnPercent.title: Warn at context percent
warnPercent.description: A toast warns once when the context passes this share of the window. 0 turns it off.

limitPercent.title: Warn at rate-limit percent
limitPercent.description: A toast warns once when a rate-limit window passes this share. 0 turns it off.

compact.title: When the context passes the compact threshold
compact.description: off: nothing. suggest: a toast tells you to run /compact. auto: Gauge compacts the conversation once the turn has ended.

compactTokens.title: Compact threshold in tokens
compactTokens.description: The context size the compact setting acts at. 0 uses the warning threshold.

historyDays.title: Days of history to keep
historyDays.description: How many days of spend /gauge history keeps.
